messages:
Oliver Chen: Heads-up — design review: I noticed discoverability problems with the rollout 'kill switch' in the version-history timeline prototype. Can we do a quick sync?
Maria Gomez: Yep, saw that. On desktop it's buried in the kebab menu; on mobile it's a tiny icon next to the variant. :exclamation: Super easy to miss during an incident.
Sasha Patel: Quick question — do we keep the term 'Kill switch'? It reads harsh and might be confusing for screen readers. Thinking 'Pause rollout' or 'Stop variant' could be clearer.
Anna Li: +1 to 'Pause rollout' for clarity. For SR we should announce 'Rollout paused' and move focus to the timeline entry (so voiceover users know what changed). Also the confirmation modal needs an accessible title and focus trap.
Jake Ramos: From eng's POV we want minimal clicks in emergencies. Can we add a top-level keyboard shortcut that triggers the same flow but still requires double-confirm? (e.g., trigger then confirm)
Maria Gomez: Let's avoid browser collisions. `Ctrl+Shift+P` could work but we should confirm across platforms. Also we need an always-visible tooltip and a 2px high-contrast focus ring for keyboard focus.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [automated message] canary rollback executed for canary-v2 at 2024-07-05T14:12Z — automated rollback smoke check passed.
Oliver Chen: Proposed compromise: add a visible 'Pause rollout' pill next to the active variant when allocation < 100%, plus a persistent 'Pause' button in the page header for org admins. On mobile the header control collapses into a persistent bottom-sheet action. This gives both discoverability and a protected path. Thoughts?
Sasha Patel: Contrast nit — current red-on-orange gradient fails AA. Suggest using #D9534F on white or adding a 2px dark outline. For SR, don't stuff the confirmation hint into the label; instead use `aria-describedby` that points at the modal explanation so screen readers get the full context.
Anna Li: Copy tweak for the modal: show affected variants + percentage and add a reversible snapshot link: 'Create rollback snapshot' as a secondary action. Keyboard behavior: Escape must close the modal and return focus to the original 'Pause' control.
Jake Ramos: Backend note: we already have a pause endpoint and audit logging. We'll add server-side debounce to prevent double calls. Rough ETA: header + shortcut support = 2 sprints, visual + modal polish = 1 sprint.
Oliver Chen: Action items — Maria update mocks for header + pill and mobile bottom-sheet; Sasha run contrast checks and draft aria-describedby text; Jake spec keyboard shortcut + debounce; Anna draft modal copy + rollback-snapshot microcopy. Sync scheduled Thu 11:00am. :calendar:
